observations.trigger: AIMelee starts when live target exists; dist<12 +NO_ANIMATION+onGround+cooldown0+notHolding selects20tick leap and sets70attempt cooldown. Otherwise cooldown>0 or water plus close<4+targetWidth and NO_ANIMATION chooses either15tick paw.
observations.model_timing: Paw variants each5tick preparation +3tick body/forelimb drive +2tick follow-through +5reset. Actor damage condition is animationTick8; matches end of second stage. Head/tail/body/hindlegs coordinate: torso lifts/leans, hindlegs counterrotate, striking forelimb swings; not isolated paw rotation. Left/right are mirrored variants, one policy credit candidate only.
observations.leap: Model5prepare+5extend+5hold+5reset. Entity stops navigation and faces target during leap, applies launch velocity on ground at ticks5..10, attempts close contact when tick>=15, then running/stealth off and holding on. No explicit once-hit latch in selected leap branch; do not claim exactly one damage attempt independent of native invulnerability.
observations.continuous_body: setupAnim resets default pose then applies keyed animation and locomotion/pose layers; running has torso/head counter-bob, slow walk has opposed torso/head flap. Sit/sleep/hold blend progress interpolated from actor previous/current values; sleep suppresses faceTarget, hold spreads forelimbs. These functions show complete-body force/attention cues, not reusable numerical assets.
observations.interrupt_and_reload_limit: AIMelee.stop clears running/stealth/holding, not explicitly current animation; selected hurt override removes attacker blessing but does not replace animation. Tick ends with Citadel AnimationHandler update. Save/load overrides persist sitting/sleeping/white, not these animation/holding fields. Inherited death, packet/reset and Citadel internals not read here; no full framework or restart guarantee.
observations.application: Compare tiger torso/hindleg counterbalance with Suanni fixed three-foot endpoint support and planted head-sweep. Preserve bronze-lion mechanical gait; learn coordinated body force and attention, do not import tiger mesh/texture/angles. Whether Suanni requires posture changes cannot be accepted from source alone and production gate remains unmet.
